name: cloudflare
description: Manage Cloudflare zones, DNS records, Registrar, Workers, Pages, KV, R2, and D1 with CLI-first workflows.

interface.longDescription: Use Cloudflare CLIs to inspect zones, manage DNS records, work with Registrar, deploy and inspect Workers, manage Pages projects, and operate KV, R2, and D1 resources. Prefer cf for zones/DNS/account APIs and wrangler for Workers/Pages/storage. Credentials are supplied through environment variables or Cloudflare CLI auth.
